decision: User explicitly deferred these three issues to the patch after v1.8.7 and authorized full v1.8.7 rollout.
release_scope_locked: Reuse passed v1.8.7 artifacts. No source changes for these issues in current rollout.

issues.title: Explain and bound long-running memory growth
issues.evidence: R7 RSS increased from 461.125 to 1177.902 MiB across 39 live blocks / 1800 seconds, with no memory pressure events. Leak versus retention is unresolved.
acceptance: Measure live allocations and RSS on real historical mainnet append/reorg workloads.
Preserve transactional persistence and snapshot isolation.
Demonstrate sustained bounded behavior with correct process/cgroup identity; do not extrapolate from a short zero-OOM window.

issues.title: Remove seed authority from mining
acceptance: Use locally validated parent and cumulative-work selection across GUI solo/pool, CLI and RPC.
Official TCP/HTTP availability, height claims and ACK/quorum votes must not authorize or veto mining.
Relay accepted blocks asynchronously with bounded retry independently of next-template eligibility.
Keep PoW, signature, UTXO, stale-parent and atomicity checks. Ordinary validated peers must suffice when both seeds/HTTP are unavailable.
Describe full-network-partition and initial-sync behavior honestly.

issues.title: Reduce cold startup and recovery duration
issues.evidence: R7 first aligned mainnet state at about 74m20s. Original R5 recovery ready after about 102m10s; full temporary trial outage about 3h26m32s.
acceptance: Profile replay and historical feature validation on actual mainnet data.
Reduce operational downtime without bypassing consensus validation or trusting unchecked UI snapshots.
Keep exact measured startup/recovery budgets in deployment planning.

constraints: No new host requested or created.
